question: If each extra year of school raises pay by about 9%, how much more does four extra years bring, in per cent?
move: Gains that stack on each other beat gains that merely add up.
ask: Which skill could I keep adding to, year after year, so the gains build on each other?
hint: Each year's 9% applies to pay already raised by the years before.
reference: Psacharopoulos & Patrinos, Returns to Investment in Education: A Decennial Review of the Global Literature, Education Economics, 2018
